scope: Audit and recommendations only; no application implementation or new live tests

priorities.P0: First useful experience; implement bounded slices
priorities.P1: Select after repeated-use evidence; not an instruction to build all

features.title: Installable Mac release and recovery
features.first_slice: Local package, checkpoint-safe backup/restore, clean stop and sleep/wake handling
features.customer_value: Makes the product usable beyond a developer machine
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Complete Phase 7 integrated scenario and restore drill on a clean data root. External distribution adds signing/notarization and an update plan
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Guided setup and task doctor
features.first_slice: Check only the selected job's model, account, browser, runtime and input requirements
features.customer_value: Reduces abandoned setup and repeated troubleshooting across all audiences
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Reuse existing health checks. Show configured, tested, expired and not tested distinctly. Preserve task drafts; native Chrome reading needs no code container, while the container-browser route requires Docker
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Result review desk
features.first_slice: Render Markdown and tables, show sources/coverage, compare versions, Accept or Request changes, exact export
features.customer_value: Turns output files into something a person can use and trust
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Reuse immutable artifacts. Separate integrity, criterion checks and owner acceptance. Untrusted result content must not run scripts in the app
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Task acceptance and quality evaluation
features.first_slice: Simple success checklist and representative task fixtures
features.customer_value: Detects plausible-looking but incomplete work
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Include planted omissions, wrong calculations and partial source coverage. Align output-size limits; no unsupported “checked” status. Evaluate live model quality separately with an explicitly chosen budget
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Ordinary file support and polished exports
features.first_slice: Start with safe source-text formats, CSV tables/charts and a reviewed report export; then PDF/XLSX parsing and DOCX
features.customer_value: Opens real business and developer work without manual conversion
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Reviewed pinned runtime dependencies, extraction coverage and bounds. Preserve spreadsheet values/types; never run macros. Test import → calculation → preview → export on the same exact versions
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Parameterized jobs
features.first_slice: Named file/input slots, output schema, sample input/output and versioned procedure
features.customer_value: Repeating a job becomes filling a form rather than rewriting prompts
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F03–F04. Reject missing/wrong inputs before paid work; three new input sets produce the promised schema; do not clone credentials or grants
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Client/project spaces and reviewed knowledge
features.first_slice: Selected briefs, rules, sources and reusable jobs
features.customer_value: Reuses context without mixing customers
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: New project access rules and independent read-input capabilities. Three conflicting client fixtures must not cross retrieval, sharing, messages or account boundaries
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Source discovery and research receipts
features.first_slice: Approved web search, selected-source fetching, citations and coverage
features.customer_value: Research can discover evidence rather than require every URL from the user
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Search-provider setup, costs and destination policy. Respect access restrictions; record retrieved dates, distinguish conflicting sources and preserve source receipts
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Selected Drive and Sheets connection
features.first_slice: Import chosen files/ranges as versioned inputs
features.customer_value: Removes repetitive exports for business reports
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: OAuth/account lifecycle, scopes, pagination, revocation and data snapshots. A stale/wrong account cannot silently supply inputs; no writes in this slice
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Gmail review beyond snippets
features.first_slice: Paginated search, explicit full-thread access and selected safe attachments
features.customer_value: Makes mail prioritization and follow-up analysis more useful
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Decompose current Gmail tool restrictions; clear account and coverage, attachment validation and new consent as needed. Keep current read-only behavior unless a separate action is approved
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Local recurring jobs
features.first_slice: Repeat a previously accepted job daily/weekly with next run, timezone and history
features.customer_value: Creates ongoing usefulness
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F01, F04, F06 and stable required sources. Durable occurrence identity, non-overlap, caps, expiry, missed-run policy and pause-all; restart/sleep cannot produce duplicate dispatch
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Change summaries and actionable notifications
features.first_slice: What changed since the accepted result; alert only when useful
features.customer_value: Reduces monitoring and notification fatigue
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F03 plus durable events; F11 for recurrence. Detect new information separately from wording changes; deep-link to the exact result/request; quiet hours and stale-action checks
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Useful browser actions
features.first_slice: Fresh-target click/fill/select, task tabs and managed downloads; form staging only where the site supports it
features.customer_value: Enables portal work and meaningful interactive checks
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Policy/broker changes and native/container capability matrix. Typing can autosave: approvals bind account, target, operation, payload and revision. Reconcile uncertain outcomes through authoritative state or idempotency; if unverifiable, stop for review without automatic replay
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Recovery view and resource queue
features.first_slice: Last successful step, cause, safe repair, waiting resource and retry history
features.customer_value: Makes troubleshooting understandable without babysitting
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Existing checkpoints, receipts and code-capacity limits. Queue two code jobs predictably; expired login, runtime loss, canceled work and unknown outcomes have distinct recovery paths
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Outcome and cost history
features.first_slice: Accepted, revised and abandoned results; intervention time; estimated spend per accepted result
features.customer_value: Helps users decide which jobs are worth keeping
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F03 acceptance state, workflow linkage and local metrics. Include failed attempts and distinguish provider estimates from invoices or self-reported time saved
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Read-only GitHub context
features.first_slice: Selected repository/commit/diff import with provenance
features.customer_value: Reduces developer copy/paste and stale source review
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F05 and a scoped connector. Pin commit and file limits; never imply a full repository was read from a partial diff
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Calendar briefing
features.first_slice: Selected calendar events plus approved context
features.customer_value: Makes personal and business daily briefs more actionable
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Read-only connector and optional F11. Exact calendar/account/timezone; no meeting edits in the first slice
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Draft and approve external actions
features.first_slice: One requested email, ticket or CRM update type
features.customer_value: Closes the gap between a recommendation and useful execution
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Stable read connector and explicit operation grants. Show account, recipient/object and exact before/after; revised drafts invalidate approval; reconcile uncertain sends
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Visible two-agent workflows
features.first_slice: Researcher → reviewer, with owner-visible assignments and shared budget
features.customer_value: Makes existing collaboration understandable
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F04/F06 and exact published handoffs. Compare against a single agent; keep only if quality or elapsed time improves enough to justify cost
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Tested playbooks
features.first_slice: Reviewed procedure, permitted tools, known inputs and held-out examples
features.customer_value: Improves specialist repeatability
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F04/F06 and versioning. Promote changes only after tests; retrieved instructions cannot self-install tools or expand authority
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Portable workflow and task packs
features.first_slice: Export selected definitions, evidence and results; import as disabled drafts
features.customer_value: Supports reuse, handover and support
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F01/F06, manifests and compatibility checks. Exclude tokens/cookies/private history by default; rebind accounts and grants after import
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Quick capture
features.first_slice: Send a selected URL/file or explicitly pasted text into a task draft
features.customer_value: Reduces friction while the user continues other work
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: Local shortcut/share entry point with preview. No background clipboard monitoring; capture creates a draft rather than silently starting paid work
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Context and model budgets suited to the job
features.first_slice: Scoped evidence retrieval, bounded artifact writing and evaluated model choices
features.customer_value: Prevents long jobs from losing evidence or repeatedly paying to read it
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F04 evaluations; retain owner caps and initial OpenAI support. Model change never changes permissions; measure quality/cost before introducing other providers
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

features.title: Visual website QA
features.first_slice: Screenshots, interactive steps and reproducible evidence
features.customer_value: Broadens agency/developer audits beyond page copy
features.dependencies_and_acceptance: F13 plus evaluated image-capable model flow and fixture sites. Separate visual checks from actual accessibility/performance tests; all findings need observable evidence
features.demand_evidence: Unvalidated; source-backed gap and product judgment, not measured customer demand

validation.discovery: 15 people, five per audience; proposed only
validation.activation: 12 Mac pilots, four per audience; at least 9 independently reach a scoped result as a proposed gate
validation.repeat_use: At least 6 of 12 accept a repeat job with new inputs in week two and at least 4 in week four; proposed small-cohort decision gates, not market fit proof
